# Invio (Invio Invoice) — Full Specification & Architecture Documentation

> Complete functional, technical, and distribution documentation for Invio Invoice (by Timrio), the free offline invoice software, POS billing app, and inventory manager for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

---

## 1. Overview & Brand Identity
- **Official Product Name**: Invio (also referred to as Invio Invoice, Invio Billing Software, and Invio Desktop by Timrio)
- **Publisher**: Timrio (https://timrio.com/)
- **Official Website**: https://invio.timrio.com/
- **Current Version**: v1.1.6
- **Supported Platforms**: Windows 10/11 (Microsoft Store & `.exe`), macOS (Apple Silicon & Intel `.dmg`), and Linux (`.AppImage` & `.deb`)

Invio Invoice is a free, privacy-first desktop invoicing and billing application built for retail shops, wholesalers, cafes, restaurants, freelancers, and small businesses. Unlike cloud SaaS billing apps that lock features behind recurring monthly subscriptions or fail when internet disconnects, Invio runs 100% locally on the user's own computer.

### Core Guarantees:
- **Free Forever Core Plan (₹0)**: Unlimited offline invoices, products, customers, GST calculations, barcode scanning, credit (udhar) ledger, and A4/A5 PDF bills with zero expiry.
- **100% Offline Capability**: Works completely without an internet connection.
- **Privacy & Ownership**: Business data stays on the user's local computer (SQLite WAL by default, with optional local-network/self-hosted PostgreSQL for multi-counter shops).

---

## 2. Plans & Pricing
- **Free Plan (₹0 forever)**: Unlimited offline invoices, GST tax splits, A4/A5 PDF printing, USB/Bluetooth barcode scanning, stock & inventory tracking, customer credit diary, 1-click backups, plus free POS Picture-Tile and Customer POS Display add-ons.
- **Invio Plus (₹149/month or ₹999/year)**: Everything in Free plus 58mm & 80mm thermal paper receipt printing, dynamic scan-and-pay UPI QR codes on slips, Restaurant Table QR ordering & Kitchen Display Screen, Gmail/SMTP automated PDF email bills, 1-click WhatsApp bill sharing, and priority email setup support.
- **Invio Pro (Coming Soon, planned ₹1,299/month or ₹9,999/year)**: Cashier & manager logins, multi-counter scaling, detailed profit & CA-ready GST reports, bulk CSV/Excel upload, and priority phone/WhatsApp support.

---

## 3. Core Features & Official Add-ons
- **GST & Regular Invoicing**: Automatic intra-state CGST+SGST and inter-state IGST calculation, HSN/SAC codes, tax-inclusive or exclusive item pricing, discounts, and branded A4/A5 PDFs.
- **Thermal Receipt Printing & UPI QR**: 58mm (2-inch) and 80mm (3-inch) ESC/POS receipt printing with silent auto-print, cash drawer kick, and dynamic offline UPI payment QR codes (`upi://pay?...`).
- **Picture-Tile POS Add-on (Free)**: Touch-friendly product photo grid with `+`/`−` controls, quick search, and compact token slip printing.
- **Customer POS Display Add-on (Free)**: Second monitor/TV counter screen showing live items, discounts, totals, store branding, and scan-and-pay UPI QR code.
- **Restaurant Add-on (Plus)**: Table map management, printable table QR standees for guest phone ordering over shop Wi-Fi (works without internet), live Kitchen Screen, and 1-click GST bill conversion.
- **Email & WhatsApp Add-ons (Plus)**: One-click Gmail OAuth or encrypted local SMTP outbox with offline retry queue, plus 1-click WhatsApp receipt sharing.
